title: UI风格#145 - Retro Terminal Green (复古终端绿)
description: 创建第145种UI风格：复古终端绿风格 - 80年代绿色屏幕、CRT显示器、命令行。输出到 G:/claude_code_project/web/index_planEO.html

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Given Retro Terminal Green style When color palette Then features phosphor green, deep black, amber glow, scanline gray
Given Retro Terminal Green style When typography Then uses terminal fonts: VT323, Share Tech Mono, or Fira Code
acceptance_criteria.evidence: Implemented: VT323 (headers 2.5rem), Share Tech Mono (body 0.9rem) - authentic terminal monospace

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Given Retro Terminal Green style When layout Then CRT curves, scanlines, terminal window, command prompt
acceptance_criteria.evidence: Implemented: CRT scanline overlay with flicker animation, terminal window frame with box-drawing characters, phosphor glow effects

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Given Retro Terminal Green style When UI elements Then phosphor glow, cursor blink, screen flicker, amber highlights
acceptance_criteria.evidence: Implemented: text-shadow glow, blinking cursor animation, screen flicker effect, amber accent highlights

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Given Retro Terminal Green UI When functional Then includes mainframe chat, sysop agents, bandwidth stats
acceptance_criteria.evidence: Implemented: mainframe chat console, 4 sysop agents (MAINFRAME-42, SYSOP-KERNEL, DEBUG-PROTOCOL, ARCHIVE-DRIVE) with MEMORY/CPU/BANDWIDTH/LATENCY/COMPILE/BOOT/DISK/INTEGRITY stats

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Given Retro Terminal Green UI When copy Then uses command line: 'Execute', 'Compile', 'System', 'Mainframe'
acceptance_criteria.evidence: Implemented: title 'EXECUTE. COMPILE. SYSTEM.', tagline 'C:\> MAINFRAME_OS v2.84', button 'EXEC', greeting 'SYSTEM ONLINE. MAINFRAME READY...', status 'ONLINE'/'IDLE', nav 'MAINFRAME'/'EXECUTE'/'COMPILE'/'ARCHIVE'
